caption: The drawing depicts two round objects, each with a wooden appearance and brownish coloration, set against a plain off-white background. Both objects are disk-shaped and feature multiple long, thin, metal spikes protruding from one side. The object on the left is shown at an angle and includes a cylindrical wooden handle attached to the center of its top surface, while the spikes radiate outward from the underside. The object on the right is displayed without a handle and is oriented to show more of the top surface, with many spikes emerging from the bottom. The disks are drawn with visible wood grain patterns and shadowing to suggest their three-dimensional form. There is a small artist signature at the bottom-right corner of the image.
title: Apothecary's Pill Coater
